title: Natural Justice Under GST: Gujarat HC Quashes Order Passed Without ...
snippet: The Gujarat High Court, in Komal Jayeshbhai Hemavat Vs State Tax Officer (4) & Anr., examined the legality of an order issued under Section 74 of the Gujarat Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (GST Act), where the assessee was denied an opportunity of personal hearing.

title: Personal Hearing Cannot Be Waived by a Click: Gujarat HC Reaffirms ...
snippet: The Gujarat High Court in Komal Jayeshbhai Hemavat v. State Tax Officer held that personal hearing under Section 75(4) of GST law is mandatory before passing an adverse order, even if the taxpayer selected 'No' in Form DRC-06. The ruling reinforces natural justice and safeguards taxpayers against ex parte GST orders.

title: Gujarat HC Quashes GST Demand Order for Violation of Natural Justice
snippet: The Gujarat High Court has set aside a GST demand order issued against Kapton Alloys Private Limited, citing a violation of the principles of natural justice.
